battle.name: 第三次馬拉塔戰爭
battle.brief: 一八一七年三月五日，東印度公司在浦那城外的卡德基迎戰辛地亞與朋斯勒聯軍，一役擊潰馬拉塔聯盟的野戰主力，隨後分別迫降三方勢力，聯邦就此瓦解。火繩槍在馬拉塔步兵線上仍是最老一代的槍械，火繩受潮熄火使齊射偏遲，射程與射速都遠不及英軍的燧發滑膛槍。

kit.name: 火繩槍
kit.history: 火繩槍要點火、要瞄、要排隊。方陣把這些弱點變成了整齊的彈幕。

countries: 英方是由東印度公司主導的混合編制：公司自有軍隊為骨架，英王國陸軍的正規團為打擊主力，另有各土邦的部隊與印度土兵作為輔助。公司總督兼孟買總督芒士蒂亞特·艾爾芬斯頓同時就是這場戰爭的英方總指揮，他在浦那前線親自率領一個師，師以下由約翰·馬爾科姆爵士、托馬斯·希斯洛普將軍等人分區指揮。步兵縱隊裡有英王國的七十四、七十八、八十七團等高地團與步兵團，孟買本地步兵、孟加拉本地步兵以及馬德拉斯工兵；騎兵是公司的第一、第二輕騎兵團與第四、第五本地騎兵團；砲兵約六門野戰砲、一門臼砲，另有一支火箭分隊。馬拉塔方則是三邦聯盟：辛地亞、朋斯勒、霍爾卡爾，加上浦那的帕什瓦。各邦軍隊互不隸屬，沒有統一指揮系統：辛地亞的野戰軍交由受過歐洲訓練的砲手與傭兵將領操縱，朋斯勒的軍隊由其宗室薩達什瓦·拉奧率領，霍爾卡爾的軍隊獨自作戰；步兵是徒步的佩達伊爾，騎兵是輕裝的馬拉塔輕騎，砲隊數量可觀且射擊嫻熟。第三方包括浦那的朝廷、背叛朋斯勒而與英方結盟的阿帕·薩希布所率的那格浦爾王公軍、依附在三邦領地裏的潘迪里匪徒，以及各土邦為維持秩序而派出的守備部隊。
countriesEn: The British side was a mixed system under the British East India Company: the Company's own armies formed the backbone, regiments of the British crown army provided the striking core, and the troops of the Indian princely states served as auxiliaries. Company Governor-General and Governor of Bombay Mountstuart Elphinstone was at the same time the British commander in this war, personally leading a division in front of Poona, with command shared below him among men such as Sir John Malcolm and General Thomas Hislop. The infantry column included the 74th, 78th and 87th Highlanders and other British foot, the 1st and 2nd Bombay Native Infantry, the 1st Bengal Native Infantry and Madras sappers; the cavalry was the 1st and 2nd Light Horse with the 4th and 5th Native Cavalry; the artillery amounted to roughly six field guns and a howitzer, with a rocket detachment attached. The Maratha side was an alliance of three states, Scindia, Bhonsle and Holkar, together with the Peshwa at Poona. Their armies were not subordinated to one another and there was no unified command system: Scindia's field army was handled by gunners and mercenary officers trained in Europe, Bhonsle's army was led by his kinsman Sadashivrao, and Holkar's army fought on its own account. Their foot was the dismounted paidal, their horse was the light Maratha cavalry, and their artillery was numerous and well served. Third parties included the court at Poona, Appa Sahib with his men, who had risen against Bhonsle and thrown in their lot with the British, the Pindari bands harboured in the three states, and the garrison troops sent out by the various princely states to keep order.
people: 英方最關鍵的人物是總督艾爾芬斯頓：作戰計畫出自他手，他決定不在浦那城內被動應戰，而把主力前推到浦那東南約十四公里的卡德基，並在同日分兵奇襲浦那城，把辛地亞與朋斯勒的聯軍釘在原地。英方騎兵在最危急的一刻被衝散，謠傳英軍全軍覆沒一度令部分步兵陣形動搖，最後扭轉局面的，是輕騎團與第四、第五本地騎兵團在營旗附近重新集結後的反擊，以及步兵方陣在砲火下保持完整。托馬斯·希斯洛普將軍在同年負責中部戰區，於十一月率遠征縱隊攻入那格浦爾，迫使朋斯勒割地。約翰·馬爾科姆爵士是公司最能幹的將領之一，浦那方向與一八一八年追擊霍爾卡爾的機動作戰都歸他調度。馬拉塔方最受矚目的是浦那的帕什瓦巴吉·拉奧二世，他本人在卡德基前線，卻目睹聯軍崩潰，兩個月後英軍入城，他的朝廷實際上只剩下空殼。辛地亞方面的野戰總指揮是波爾曼，這位漢諾威出身的前歐洲軍官把數千人和十二門砲經營成一支訓練良好的軍隊，卻在幾個小時內被方陣與火箭打散；卡德基前線的實際指揮則是薩達什瓦·拉奧·朋斯勒，他的騎兵一再衝擊方陣而不得其果，最後率殘部北撤，辛地亞一方的談判也由波爾曼經手，於十二月簽訂 Surji-Anjangaon 條約。那格浦爾方面，拉戈吉二世被迫退位讓地，起義的阿帕·薩希布則在英方支持下成為那格浦爾王公。西部戰線的耶什萬特·拉奧·霍爾卡爾獨自應戰，一八一八年初在馬爾瓦被英軍追擊到放棄抵抗，最後簽下 Munjeshwar 條約。辛地亞的姻親辛布拉奧則在十二月十六日的馬希德普爾戰役中被當地村吏與村民以刀殺死，成為壓垮該翼的關鍵打擊。
peopleEn: The decisive figure on the British side was Governor-General Elphinstone: the plan of the campaign was his, and he chose not to be pinned down in Poona but to march the main body out to Khadki, some fourteen kilometres southeast of the city, while on the same day a detachment struck at Poona itself, pinning the Scindia-Bhonsle allied army where it stood. The British cavalry was scattered at the most critical moment, and a false report that the whole British force had been destroyed briefly shook the infantry order of battle; what turned the day was the rally of the Light Horse with the 4th and 5th Native Cavalry near the camp colours, together with the infantry squares holding their shape under the Maratha guns. General Thomas Hislop commanded in the central theatre in the same year and led a flying column into Nagpur in November, forcing Bhonsle to cede territory. Sir John Malcolm was among the Company's most capable generals, and was trusted with the Poona direction and later with the mobile campaign that hunted Holkar down in 1818. The most famous Maratha figure of all was the Peshwa Baji Rao II, who was personally on the field at Khadki and watched his allies collapse; two months later the British entered Poona and his court was little more than an empty shell. The field command of Scindia's army lay with Pohlmann, a former Hanoverian officer who had turned several thousand men and twelve guns into a well-drilled force, and who saw that force broken in a few hours by squares and rockets; the actual command on the Khadki field was Sadashivrao Bhonsle, whose cavalry charged the squares again and again without effect before he withdrew north with the remnants, and the negotiation that followed was handled by Pohlmann, producing the Treaty of Surji-Anjangaon in December. At Nagpur, Raghoji II was forced to give way on his claims, while the rebel Appa Sahib was installed as prince of Nagpur with British support. Yashwant Rao Holkar fought alone in the western theatre, was run down in Malwa in early 1818 and gave up resistance, signing the Treaty of Munjeshwar. Scindia's kinsman Trimbak Rao was killed with a blade at the village of Mahidpur on 16 December, and that blow was what finally broke that wing.
kits: 這張卡的兵器是火繩槍。火繩槍是十六世紀的歐洲產物，西班牙最早把它用成制式步兵槍，十七世紀經荷蘭、法國與波斯傳入莫臥兒，再由莫臥兒與印度土邦一系承襲，到一八一七年仍是印度戰線上最普遍、也最老的一代步兵槍械。它的優點是結構簡單、不依賴昂貴的燧石機件，適合大量徵發、裝備落後的印度步兵；缺點同樣明顯：必須靠一根慢燃的火繩保持火種，風大、光線不足或潮濕都會讓火繩熄滅，射手還要在射擊前把火繩移到待發位置，因此每分鐘只有兩到三發，射程多在兩百碼以內，火繩存量往往是馬拉塔步兵真正的火力上限。一八一七年的卡德基，馬拉塔聯軍的徒步步兵線上仍以火繩槍為主，射擊習慣是接近到三四百步才列隊齊射，火力猛、覆蓋面大，卻不精確；英方主力則是燧發滑膛槍，火繩槍只在部分孟買與馬德拉斯團中留有殘餘，線上換裝是在這場戰爭之後才全面完成。除了火繩槍，交戰雙方大量使用燧發滑膛槍；馬拉塔騎兵使用土爾瓦爾式彎刀、長柄矛與鑲靶小盾，步兵另有火繩盒與標槍；英方有六門野戰砲、一門臼砲與一支火箭分隊，馬拉塔方有約十二門野戰砲，由受過歐洲訓練的砲手操縱，射程與射擊紀律都受稱道。雙方的後勤都靠牛拉貨車與快運牛車，彈藥與火繩由隨軍牛車輸送，一旦行軍拉長，馬拉塔步兵的火繩存量就先見底。
kitsEn: The weapon on this card is the matchlock musket. The matchlock was a sixteenth-century European product: Spain was the first to turn it into a standard infantry arm, and in the seventeenth century it travelled through the Dutch, the French and Persia into the Mughal army, from where the Mughals and the Indian princely houses took it over; by 1817 it was still the commonest and also the oldest generation of infantry musket on every Indian battlefield. Its virtue is simplicity: it needs no costly flint mechanism, which suits the mass levy of poorly equipped Indian infantry. Its defects are just as clear. A slow-burning match has to be kept alight, wind, poor light and damp will put it out, and the shooter must move the match to the waiting position before firing; the rate of fire is therefore only two or three rounds a minute, the useful range little beyond two hundred yards, and the number of matches in the pouch is in practice the real ceiling on the Maratha footman's rate of fire. At Khadki in 1817 the Maratha foot was still armed mainly with matchlocks, and its habit was to come up to three or four hundred yards before firing in line: heavy, sweeping fire, but not accurate. The British depended on flintlock muskets, and matchlocks survived only as residue in some Bombay and Madras regiments; the conversion of the Indian line was completed only after this war. Alongside the matchlock, both sides used flintlock muskets in quantity. The Maratha horse carried the tulwar, a long lance and padded target shields, while their foot carried match boxes and musket rest; on the British side stood six field guns, a howitzer and a rocket detachment, against roughly twelve Maratha field guns served by gunners trained in Europe, whose range and discipline were admired. Logistics on both sides ran on bullock carts and fast ox transport, with ammunition and match going forward in the same carts, and when a column was stretched out it was the Maratha match supply that ran out first.
tactics: 卡德基是一場典型的以步兵方陣對輕騎衝鋒的會戰。英軍在穆塔河畔列陣，把步兵結成實心方陣，四面以刺刀牆朝外，射擊時前沿的分隊輪流開火、後排裝填，火箭分隊在方陣側翼以齊射壓制衝鋒前綴。馬拉塔軍先以約十二門砲在一段距離外展開射擊，試圖打亂英軍的線列，未能奏效後改以輕騎連續衝鋒，一波接一波地貼上刺刀牆砍刺，企圖撕開缺口；方陣因此成了絞肉機，火繩槍的齊射在近距離內火力齊整，但射速遲緩、覆蓋不到側翼。英方在方陣內以火箭齊射與步兵輪替射擊維持火力密度，傷亡在整個上午緩慢累積。英方騎兵在最關鍵的一刻被衝散，馬拉塔騎兵一度逼近營帳，但英方騎兵在營旗附近重新集結後的反擊，以及步兵方陣在砲火下保持完整，使馬拉塔騎兵失去衝鋒節奏，被迫退向河岸與村落，聯軍的步兵線也在遲緩的齊射與英軍線列射擊之間崩解。戰術上雙方都犯了同一個錯：馬拉塔聯軍把分屬不同邦的軍隊擺在同一條正面，指揮無法統一，騎兵衝鋒缺少步兵與砲兵的協同節拍；英軍則在情報上誤判對方兵力集中程度，屢次讓騎兵單獨承受衝鋒。戰役之後英軍沒有長驅直搗浦那，而是分別封鎖北方與東北方，以封鎖加談判的組合同時向三方施壓；同年十一月轉向那格浦爾，以連續行軍解圍，攻城與夜襲交替；一八一八年初在馬爾瓦一帶側擊霍爾卡爾的縱隊，用斷糧與機動作戰把對方逼到談判桌前。
tacticsEn: Khadki was a classic meeting of infantry squares against light cavalry. The British deployed on the bank of the Mutha, closing the foot into solid squares with the bayonet wall turned outwards, the front rank firing while the rear ranks loaded, and the rocket detachment standing on the flanks to blanket the approach of the charging horse. The Marathas first opened with their dozen guns at long range, trying to disorder the British line, and when that failed turned to repeated cavalry charges, wave after wave riding up to the bayonets to cut and open a gap. The square turned into a grinder: the matchlock volley was dense at close range but slow, and could not reach the flanks. The British sustained the density of fire with rocket volleys and alternating infantry volleys, and casualties accumulated slowly through the whole morning. The British horse was scattered at the decisive moment and the Maratha horse came within reach of the camp, but the rally of the cavalry near the colours and the squares holding together under the guns took the Maratha charge out of rhythm and drove it back towards the river and the villages; the Maratha infantry line then dissolved between the slow matchlock volleys and the British line-of-battle fire. Both sides made the same tactical mistake. The Marathas had massed two armies belonging to different states on one front with no unified command, so the cavalry charges had no coordinated rhythm with the infantry and the guns; the British, for their part, misjudged how concentrated the enemy force really was and repeatedly left the cavalry to absorb the charge alone. After the battle they did not storm Poona but sealed the north and the north-east, combining blockade with negotiation to press all three states at once; in November they turned against Nagpur, relieving it by forced marching and alternating siege with night attack; and in early 1818 they struck Holkar's columns in Malwa, using denial of supplies and mobile movement to force him to the negotiating table.
data: 卡德基會戰於一八一七年三月五日爆發，戰場在浦那城東南約十四公里（九英里）的穆塔河畔。英軍總兵力約四千人，其中英王國歐洲步兵約二千人（以七十四、七十八、八十七團等為主），印度步兵約一千三百至一千五百人，騎兵約一千二百人（第一、第二輕騎兵團與第四、第五本地騎兵團），砲兵六門野戰砲與一門臼砲，另有一支火箭分隊；馬拉塔聯軍約六千人，部分英方估計給到八千人，其中步兵約四千人、騎兵約二千人，野戰砲約十二門。英方公報記錄英軍損失為陣亡十七人、受傷五十四人；英方宣稱馬拉塔方面約二千人陣亡、約一千人被俘，並繳獲十一門砲。火繩槍的射速約每分鐘二至三發、有效射程多在兩百碼內，燧發滑膛槍則可達每分鐘四至五發。戰爭自一八一七年三月延續至一八一八年年底，主要戰鬥集中在三月與十一、十二月：浦那城於三月五日被英軍奇襲佔領，十一月英軍遠征縱隊連續行軍約一晝夜、走了六十公里左右解那格浦爾之圍；十二月十六日有馬希德普爾之戰，十二月三十日簽訂 Surji-Anjangaon 條約；一八一八年一月二十七日霍爾卡爾簽訂 Munjeshwar 條約；帕什瓦於一八一八年六月被逐出浦那，同年十二月在浦那投降領取年金。
dataEn: The battle of Khadki was fought on 5 March 1817 on the bank of the Mutha, some fourteen kilometres (nine miles) southeast of Poona. The British force numbered about four thousand men, of whom roughly two thousand were European infantry of the crown army (chiefly the 74th, 78th and 87th regiments), Indian infantry numbered some one thousand three hundred to one thousand five hundred, and cavalry about one thousand two hundred men (the 1st and 2nd Light Horse and the 4th and 5th Native Cavalry); the artillery was six field guns and a howitzer, with a rocket detachment. The Maratha allied army was about six thousand strong, put by some British estimates at eight thousand, made up of roughly four thousand foot and two thousand horse, with about twelve field guns. The British official return gives British losses as seventeen killed and fifty-four wounded; the British claimed some two thousand Maratha dead, about a thousand prisoners, and eleven guns captured. A matchlock musket fired two to three rounds a minute with a useful range generally inside two hundred yards, against four to five rounds a minute for the flintlock musket. The war itself ran from March 1817 to the end of 1818, with the main fighting in March and in November and December: Poona was seized by a coup de main on 5 March; in November the British flying column relieved Nagpur after a forced march of about sixty kilometres in a round-the-clock day and night; there was a battle at Mahidpur on 16 December; the Treaty of Surji-Anjangaon was signed on 30 December; Holkar signed the Treaty of Munjeshwar on 27 January 1818; the Peshwa was driven out of Poona in June 1818 and surrendered at Poona in December of the same year on a pension.
cause: 一八一七年的開戰，是東印度公司在印度中部擴張到臨界點後的一次總清帳。第一，第二次英馬戰爭之後，辛地亞雖被迫割地，卻仍握有一支由歐洲教練訓練、裝備完整的野戰軍，這支軍隊在德干中部並不受浦那朝廷節制；第二，一八一三至一五年間平定潘迪里匪亂時，辛地亞與朋斯勒的領地成了匪徒的藏身地，公司要求各邦交出藏匿者並開放土地追剿，遭到拒絕；第三，公司在浦那、貝拉爾與馬爾瓦的擴張需要把附庸同盟的權力落到實處，於是向三方提出最後通牒：解散大部分野戰軍、割讓土地、繳出砲兵、接受補助費制度。這三條同時觸碰三邦的核心利益——軍隊是三邦的國本，土地是稅源，砲兵是獨立的談判本錢。浦那的帕什瓦巴吉·拉奧二世則在自己的朝廷與公司的附庸體系之間掙扎，公司需要一個能合作的帕什瓦，而不是一個靠軍隊維持自主的帕什瓦。制度上，這場衝突也反映公司軍隊的現實：英王國正規團比例下降，印度土兵大量充當主力，公司的火力、砲兵與財政都更依賴對土邦的實際控制，因此清除一支部立在德干的獨立軍隊，同時就是擴大公司的稅基。
causeEn: The war of 1817 was a final reckoning that the East India Company could no longer postpone once its expansion across central India reached its limit. First, after the Second Anglo-Maratha War, Scindia had been forced to cede territory but still held a field army drilled by European instructors and fully equipped, an army in the Deccan that was not controlled by the court at Poona. Second, while the Pindari bands were being hunted down between 1813 and 1815, the territories of Scindia and Bhonsle served as their refuge, and the Company's demand that these states give up the fugitives and open their lands for pursuit was refused. Third, the Company's advance into Poona, Berar and Malwa required the fiction of subsidiary alliance to be made real, so a final ultimatum went to all three states: disband the greater part of the field armies, cede territory, surrender the guns, and accept the subsidy system. Each of these struck at the three states' life blood, since the army was the standing institution of a Maratha state, land was its revenue, and the guns were its independent leverage in negotiation. The Peshwa Baji Rao II in Poona was caught between his own court and the Company's system of subsidiary alliances; the Company wanted a compliant Peshwa rather than one who sustained himself with an army of his own. There was an institutional dimension as well. The proportion of British crown regiments was falling, Indian sepoys made up the greater part of the fighting line, and the Company's firepower, artillery and revenue all depended more and more on effective control of the princely states; removing an independent army standing in the Deccan and annexing its revenue were the same operation.
impact: 第三次馬拉塔戰爭的直接後果，是馬拉塔聯邦作為一個能打仗的聯盟不再存在。辛地亞、朋斯勒與霍爾卡爾各自成了公司的附庸，野戰軍被解散或削到極小，砲兵被繳或被限制，公司以附庸同盟的名義取得了德干中部、貝拉爾與馬爾瓦的稅收與駐軍權，中印度的秩序從此在公司的直接管治下重建，附庸同盟制度也從此成為英屬印度的骨架，隨後三十年的土邦兼併幾乎都是沿著一八一七至一八年的這份結果往前推。武器史上的意義同樣清楚：火繩槍在印度軍隊裡的最後一代服役兵在這一戰之後退出生番，線上換裝燧發滑膛槍的工作在一八一八至三〇年代陸續完成，印度步兵線的火種、瞄準與射速問題從此不再是軍隊的瓶頸，而這正是把火繩槍最終從印度軍械名錄上抹去的實際過程。人事上，浦那的帕什瓦制度正式終結，巴吉·拉奧二世在浦那投降後領取年金，浦那改由公司直接管治，那格浦爾則由阿帕·薩希布接位、朋斯勒退守貝拉爾。馬拉塔輕騎作為一支獨立的軍事力量就此終結，它的衝鋒紀律與戰術傳說被英軍寫進教材，同時流入公司的輔助軍與後來的土邦部隊，於是在下一次大戰裡，馬拉塔騎兵是以附庸而不是以獨立軍隊的身分再出現。
impactEn: The direct consequence of the Third Anglo-Maratha War was the end of the Maratha Confederacy as a fighting alliance. Scindia, Bhonsle and Holkar each became subsidiary allies of the Company; their field armies were disbanded or cut to a handful, their guns surrendered or restricted, and under the name of subsidiary alliance the Company took the revenue and the right to garrison in central Deccan, Berar and Malwa. The order of central India was thereafter rebuilt under direct Company administration, and the subsidiary alliance system became the framework of British India, with almost thirty years of further annexation of princely states pushing forward from what was settled in 1817 and 1818. The meaning for the history of arms is equally clear. The last generation of Indian soldiers to serve with the matchlock musket left the colours after this war; the conversion of the Indian line to flintlock muskets was carried through from 1818 into the 1830s, and the problems of ignition, sighting and rate of fire ceased to be the army's bottleneck. That was the practical process by which the matchlock was finally struck off the Indian ordnance list. In personal terms the Peshwa dynasty ended: Baji Rao II surrendered at Poona on a pension, Poona passed to direct Company administration, Appa Sahib took the gadi at Nagpur and Bhonsle was reduced to Berar. The Maratha horse ceased to exist as an independent military force; its discipline and its tactical legends were written into British textbooks and flowed into the Company's auxiliary and later princely troops, so that in the next great war the Maratha horse returned as auxiliaries rather than as an independent army.
result: 英方全勝。一八一七年三月五日的卡德基會戰摧毀了辛地亞與朋斯勒的野戰主力，聯軍損失大半砲兵與輜重，辛地亞退往北方，朋斯勒退回貝拉爾；同日英軍奇襲入浦那城，帕什瓦的朝廷失去實力。同年十一月，英軍遠征縱隊解那格浦爾之圍，攻城後迫使拉戈吉二世讓出那格浦爾並接受駐軍與補助費條件，起義的阿帕·薩希布則受立為王公；十二月十六日辛迪亞一翼在馬希德普爾被殲，辛布拉奧陣亡；十二月三十日，辛地亞在 Surji-Anjangaon 簽訂條約，割讓土地、裁減軍隊、繳出砲兵，成為公司的附庸。一八一八年一月二十七日，屢戰屢敗又糧援斷絕的霍爾卡爾在 Munjeshwar 簽訂條約，讓出納爾姆達河以北與馬爾瓦的大片土地，軍力受限，同樣納入附庸體系。一八一八年六月，浦那再度易手，巴吉·拉奧二世被逐出城池，輾轉數月後於同年十二月在浦那投降，領取年金虛度餘生。到一八一八年底，馬拉塔三邦已無一能獨立地組織野戰軍，第三次馬拉塔戰爭以英方決定性勝利與馬拉塔獨立的終結收場。
resultEn: The British won outright. The battle of Khadki on 5 March 1817 destroyed the field army of Scindia and Bhonsle, costing the allies most of their guns and baggage; Scindia withdrew northward and Bhonsle fell back towards Berar. The same day a British coup de main took Poona, and the Peshwa's court lost its substance. In November the British flying column relieved Nagpur, and the siege that followed forced Raghoji II to give up Nagpur and accept the terms of a garrison and a subsidy, with the rebel Appa Sahib installed as prince. On 16 December the Scindian wing was destroyed at Mahidpur, where Trimbak Rao was killed; on 30 December Scindia signed the Treaty of Surji-Anjangaon, ceding territory, cutting his army and surrendering his guns, and became a subsidiary ally. On 27 January 1818, defeated again and starved of supply, Holkar signed the Treaty of Munjeshwar, giving up the lands north of the Narmada and much of Malwa, his forces restricted and his state drawn into the same subsidiary system. In June 1818 Poona changed hands once more, the Peshwa Baji Rao II was driven out of the city, and after months of wandering he surrendered at Poona in December of that year to live on a pension. By the end of 1818 no one of the three Maratha states could organise a field army of its own, and the Third Anglo-Maratha War closed with a decisive British victory and the end of Maratha military independence.
